scripts.dev: concurrently -n livekit,server,client -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev:livekit" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client-v2 && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client-v2 && cp -n .env.example .env 2>/dev/null || true
